content.text: Attempt 12 has started at turn 1, with all 14 units back. I'm reading the opening state and then running the proven T1-T6 opening.

content.content:
965	"Seize gate" (in-game "Ch. 30: Victory or Death"; no prep screen). Map 28x30. The gate (24,3) is in the NE, behind 2C walls; it is entered from (24,4). The boss (ch85, cls23, 68 HP, Def 21, Res 25, Bolting x5 at 3-10 + Fimbulvetr 1-2) sits on it. The army starts in the SW corner (x0-7, rows 25-29) with Merlinus's tent at (3,29). Renault's ruins are at (5,2) in the NW (visit within 11 turns).
966	
967	**Recruits:**
968	
969	| character   | starts as | recruit with / action            | important condition            |
970	| ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
971	| **renault** | ruins     | **visit the northwestern ruins** | must do so **within 11 turns** |
972	
973	**Agent notes:**
974	
975	**s38 attempt 1 (RESTARTED on turn 14 after Matthew (T2), Nils (T5) and Wil (T13) died; Merlinus's tent was knocked out T12).**
976	- **Sage E#12 (9,17), Bolting 3-10:** it kills Res-0 units from 16 tiles away (Matthew died T2). Kill it on T2-3; it walks onto the fort (5,21). Marcus 23x2 kills it with no counter (it equips Bolting).
977	- Turn-1 wedge in the corner worked: Marcus/Hawkeye/Hector walls, the rest on tiles `fe7_threat` shows as '.'. The two paladins from the forts (4,20)/(5,21) died on Marcus's counters on EP1. The generals (13,22-24) and the warrior arrive T3-5 and die to Pent's Elfire (Res 2-4, doubles) and Rapier/axes.
978	- **Ballistas (trap array 0x0203A518): Iron Ballista (3,11), Ballista (4,25) (empty, next to the start), Iron (19,28), Iron (11,17), Killer (16,11), (17,1), (26,9). Range is about 15 tiles, not 10.** Sniper E#20 walks onto (3,11) on T4 and one-shot Nils at distance 15. E#21 sits on (19,28).
979	- **Reinforcements, every turn from about T6:** NW fighters/warriors appear AT (0-1,9-12) (T7), lance cavalry and paladins at (1,0)/(3,0)/(7-9,0-1), fighters at (16,0), nomad troopers (steel bow + steel sword, Spd 15-18) at the SE forts (26-27,28-29), wyverns at (27,16-18), and **paladins spawn on the start-area forts (4,20)/(5,21) from T11**. By T10 there were 49 enemies. The 8 centre wyvern lords and the falcon knights start moving about T12.
980	- The west corridor (x0-1, rows 15-19; x2-4 are peaks) is a good 2-wide choke. But the army got squeezed between the NW waves and the SE nomads, with fliers landing on the peaks.
981	- **Mistake: a canto after rescue can't cross the forest (1,19)** (mounted forest cost). Eliwood got stranded at (2,21) carrying Nino at half Spd and dropped to 8 HP. Check `fe7_reachable` before relying on canto.
982	- **Next attempt:** turtle T1-5 the same way but keep Res-0/flier units out of the sage's reach on T1-2. Then move FAST. Turtling at the start just lets the reinforcement waves pile up, and the goal is a seize.
983	
984	**s38 attempt 2 (RESTARTED on turn 13 after Dart and Wil (T11) and Nils and Matthew (T12) died).**
985	- **T1-T5 opening, no deaths (copy this):** use the T1 corner wedge plus trades: Pent gives an Elixir to Nils, Louise gives Elfire to Pent, Lyn gives the Killer Axe to Hector, Dart gives the Killer Bow to Louise. On T2-T4 **carry every soft unit** (Eliwood-Nils, Hector-Wil, Hawkeye-Nino, Lyn-Florina, Pent-Matthew, Marcus-Dart) so the Bolting sage has only tanks to hit. On T5 the sage walks next to the group: Louise's Silver Bow kills it (17x2). Pent's Elfire and Marcus finish the generals and the warrior on T4-T5. **The convoy holds only a Killing Edge, Fire and Lightning.**
986	- `fe7_act`'s Rapier/Killer Axe `weapon_slot` was refused ("single entry") in this attempt; only slot 0 got used. A forecast with `weapon_slot` re-equips, but it failed the same way.
987	- **The NW lance reinforcements (cls33) are FLIERS.** Louise's bows are effective (30x2, one-round). They arrive in pairs from (1,0)/(3,0) every turn from T6 and reach the SW corner around T10. SE nomad troopers (steel bow + steel sword, AS 15-18) arrive in pairs every turn from T8 and reach the SW around T11. Paladins spawn on the start forts (4,20)/(5,21) from T11. The centre wyvern pack plus 2 falcon knights start moving around T11-12. By T12 there were 50 enemies.
988	- **Sitting in the SW corner fails.** Fliers and bows reach any soft unit that isn't fully enclosed or carried, and a dropped unit can't act or move on its next turn. The ballista sniper at (19,28) shot a tank once; the one at (3,11) waits for weak targets.
989	- Next plan: clear the opening the same way (T1-T5), then march at once, with softies carried.
990	
991	**s38/s41 attempt 3 (RESTARTED on turn 16 after Canas (T3), Nino (T4), then Marcus and the Matthew he carried (EP15) died).**
992	- The opening went as planned, then the army went north up the west corridor (x0-1, rows 13-19). By T13-15 it was boxed at rows 13-14 x0-4. Fighters and paladins came from the north, 4-6 nomad troopers and cavaliers came up the corridor from the south (nomads DO enter forest; one reached (1,15) from (2,20) in one turn), and wyverns plus a wyvern lord came from the east. With 4 real tanks (Hector, Marcus, Hawkeye, Pent) and 10 soft units, every formation was one body short. Marcus (40/40 HP, carrying Matthew, so half speed and doubled) died in one enemy phase to nomad bows plus fighters.
993	- **Carrying halves Skl too**: carriers' hit rates fall to 30-60%. Only Pent (unencumbered) and Louise's effective bows are reliable killers. Nomad troopers (AS 16-17) double any carrier and Lyn.
994	- `fe7_act` bug: after a free `trade`, the resumed `attack` committed a Wait (no damage). Do the trade with one unit and the attack with another, or attack first.
995	- Leaving a weak enemy (1-6 HP) next to a wall unit works as a cork; killing it opens the tile to a stronger enemy.
996	- Next attempt: do NOT walk into the west corridor. It is where the NW waves, the south fort/nomad waves and the wyvern pack converge.
997	- Correction: slot #13 (ch28, cls44, 28 HP, at (3,29)) is **Merlinus's tent**, not Canas. Its "death" only means he retreats. Canas isn't in this chapter.
998	
999	**s41 attempt 4 (in progress; notes written at T21).**
1000	- T1-T6 opening with no deaths: the T1 corner wedge and trades, then carry Matthew, Nils, Wil, Nino and Florina on T2. On T3 the sage walks onto the (5,21) fort: Hawkeye **takes** Matthew off Marcus, and the unencumbered Marcus doubles the sage (23x2, no counter). The generals and the warrior then die to Pent and the tanks on T4-T6.
1001	- After T6 the army moved east into the south strip (x8-12, rows 26-29). This strip is outside the wyvern nest's reach, so the only threats are waves arriving piecemeal. **Wyvern lure:** an unencumbered Marcus at full HP on (13,24), a tile only 2 nest wyverns can reach, killed 2 wyverns on counters in one enemy phase. The 6-wyvern nest at (14-16,15-18) never moves unless a unit enters its range.
1002	- **The (19,28) iron ballista sniper (E#21) hits anything in the strip (~18-21 to soft units).** It killed Nino and nearly killed Lyn twice. Keep the lords carried or at full HP while in its range. Kill it before lingering in the south.
1003	- Florina died after being dropped as a wall to shield Lyn. Nino died to the ballista.
1004	- `fe7_act` quirks: (1) a **mounted unit that GIVES gets put straight into canto** with only Wait offered, so it cannot then rescue (a foot unit can). (2) After a trade, the tool often can't find the menu; do the attack or staff by hand. (3) Carried units can be traded with directly (Hawkeye traded with Pent's passenger Nils), so a carried unit's Elixir is reachable. (4) Hector's attack was refused with weapon_slot for Silver/Killer Axe ("single entry"); only his Iron Axe ever came up.
1005	
1006	**s41 attempt 4 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 43 (Eliwood killed by the (3,11) ballista at 14 tiles). Deaths before that: Florina, Nino, Marcus (EP28), Wil (EP31), Pent and Louise (EP38), Nils (EP39).**
1007	- **Reinforcements STOP.** The enemy count sat at the 50 cap until about T35, then fell: 44 (T36), 37 (T38), 29 (T40), 24 (T43), with no new spawns. After that every remaining enemy is static (nest, snipers, shamans, NW cls0C pair, sage, boss), and the whole SW (x0-12, rows 20-29) shows '.' on `fe7_threat`. **A future attempt only has to survive about 35 turns with healing to spare, then walk.**
1008	- **`fe7_threat` ignores ballistas.** The iron ballista at (3,11) (sniper E#20) killed a 5-HP Eliwood standing on (3,25), 14 tiles away, on a "safe" tile. Treat everything within about 15 tiles of (3,11), (19,28), (11,17), (16,11), (17,1) and (26,9) as unsafe for a wounded unit.
1009	- **The south-strip turtle at (9-12,26-29) held about 12 turns but bled out.** Fliers stand on the peaks, so the "pocket" (11,29) has a hole at (12,29). Eliwood carrying Lyn has half Spd and gets doubled by every wyvern (14x2 per phase). The six Elixirs and Mend ran out by T35; once Pent died the attempt was over. Weapons wore out too: Hawkeye's Killer and Silver Axes broke by T38, and Hector is down to an Iron Axe x17.
1010	- What worked: Hawkeye's Killer Axe crits (54%). Louise's effective bows on wyverns (Killer Bow, 50% crit). Pent's Elfire (Res 2-3 soldiers and wyvern lords die in one hit). Leaving 1-12 HP soldiers next to Hector as corks (they deal him 0). Eliwood taking Elixirs from carried units (Nils) or from Pent by trade, then drinking.
1011	- **Boss numbers (read): Mag 24, Skl 20, Spd 17, Def 21, Res 25, 68 HP.** Bolting x5 (3-10) plus a 1-2 tome. No physical unit we had did more than about 15 per hit, so keep Hawkeye's Killer Axe and Lyn's Silver Axe x20 for him. Lyn carries a Silver Axe, Hero Crest and Blue Gem; Dart carries a Silver Bow and an Iron Axe.
1012	- Tool notes: `fe7_act` trade/item/staff very often reports "action menu could not be located" (Pent, Eliwood, Louise). The manual path always worked: `fe7_inspect` the unit, then A, (move), A for the menu, then Item = Down from the top, Up wraps to the last item, then A, A. Trading with a CARRIED unit through `fe7_act` targets the carrier; do it by hand and cycle the list with Down.
1013	
1014	**s41 attempt 5 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 14 (Lyn killed in the SW corner). Dart died EP13.**
1015	- Opening again cost nothing through T7. T1: the soft units stand on the corner tiles `fe7_threat` shows as '.'; Louise swaps an Elfire for one of Pent's Elixir stacks; Lyn gives the Killer Axe to Hawkeye. Marcus fronts at (3,26), and both fort paladins die on his counters. T2: carry Nils (Eliwood), Wil (Hector), Matthew (Hawkeye), Nino (Pent) and Florina (Lyn). Louise gives Marcus an Elixir. T3: the sage walks onto the (5,21) fort; Marcus doubles it from (4,21), 24x2, no counter. Pent's Elfire plus Hawkeye's Silver Axe kill the general (7,27); Hector chips the knights. T4: Pent and Louise kill the warrior.
1016	- **CONFIRMED: a unit standing on a reinforcement fort blocks that spawn.** With Marcus on (5,21), soldiers kept appearing on (4,20) but never on (5,21), on two separate turns. The spawn resumed the turn he left.
1017	- **Ballista range is at least 14 tiles.** The (19,28) iron ballista hit Dart for 21 at (5,28), 14 tiles away. Corner tiles x0-3, rows 26-29 are 16 or more tiles from both (19,28) and (3,11).
1018	- The corner fortress worked while it was intact: lords at (0,29)/(1,29), walls at (0,28)/(1,28)/(2,28), Hawkeye (0,27), Hector (1,27), tent (3,29). **It failed the moment I pulled the walls out (T12-14) to chase nomads.** That left (1,28)/(2,29) open, and a wyvern lord from the nest, which starts moving about T12, reached Lyn. RULE: never move a wall unit while a lord sits inside; let enemies come to the walls and only shoot from inside.
1019	- Dart (def 6) is not a wall: three nomads (steel bow + steel sword) killed him from full HP on a 3-threat tile. Marcus burns lances fast on a fort (8 + 12 uses gone by T13); give him Hawkeye's Silver and Killer Lances on T1-2.
1020	
1021	**s41 attempt 6 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 12 (Lyn killed at (1,29) while carrying Nils). Merlinus's tent fell EP11.**
1022	- **Carrying halves Spd, so a carrier gets doubled.** Lyn (29 HP, def 6) carrying Nils was doubled by an enemy reaching her (most likely a nomad's bow from (3,29) once the tent fell). A lord must never carry anyone on a tile any enemy can reach, even at range 2.
1023	- **Merlinus's tent is a weak wall.** Every unit targets it (28 HP, def 7): the sage's Bolting, the general and wyverns. Once it falls, (3,29) opens next to the inner tiles. Only a staff user standing next to it (2,28)/(2,29)/(3,28)/(4,29) can heal it.
1024	- **Merlinus's convoy** (the Merch command when standing next to the tent) holds Fire x40, Lightning and a Killing Edge. Pent starts with no tome if Louise's Elfires go elsewhere; take Fire from the convoy on T1-2 (deposit an Elixir first if Pent is full). Merch then Staff in the same turn works.
1025	- **Plan for attempt 7 (v4 corner fortress, all 13 units, no carrier on any reachable tile):**
1026	
1027	| Tile | Unit | Why it is safe enough |
1028	| --- | --- | --- |
1029	| (0,29) | Lyn + Nils | reachable by nothing, not even at range 2 |
1030	| (0,28) | Eliwood + Wil | reachable by nothing, not even at range 2 |
1031	| (1,29) | Dart + Florina | safe while the tent stands |
1032	| (1,28) | Pent, unencumbered | healing hub next to Hector, Marcus, Eliwood and Dart |
1033	| (0,27) | Louise, unencumbered | only northern bows reach her |
1034	| (2,29) | Matthew + Nino | reachable only through the tent side; losing him costs a unit, not a lord |
1035	| (2,28) | Marcus | outer wall |
1036	| (1,27) | Hector, unencumbered | outer wall |
1037	| (0,26) | Hawkeye, unencumbered | outer wall |
1038	| (3,29) | Merlinus's tent | 4th wall, with 2 open sides |
1039	
1040	  Give Hawkeye and Marcus their own Elixir stacks, since Pent cannot reach (0,26). Walls NEVER move; they attack only what is adjacent. Survive to about T35 (reinforcements stop), then march.
1041	
1042	**s41 attempt 7 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 36 (Eliwood killed on the outer tile (1,27)). Before that: Dart (EP12), Florina (EP14), Nino (EP16), Wil (EP17), Marcus (EP29), Matthew (EP35).**
1043	- **The v4 fortress held for 35 turns.** It is the right shape. The enemy count fell 50, 46, 43, 39 over T34-36, so reinforcements really do stop around T35. Reaching T36 with Lyn, Eliwood, Hector, Pent, Louise, Hawkeye and Nils alive is enough to win.
1044	- **The leak was the tent again.** It fell EP11. After that, nomad bows on (3,29) or (1,27) reached the carried pairs on (1,29) and (2,29) at range 2, one per phase. The fix: Pent's first job every turn is to heal the tent (stand on (2,28) or (2,29) early). Otherwise, put Hector or Hawkeye on (3,29) the moment it falls, and never leave a soft unit within range 2 of an open tile.
1045	- **The fatal mistake: after killing the cork nomad on (1,27), I moved Eliwood (33/33, Def 10) onto that outer tile to close the ring.** Ten enemies could attack it; he died in one phase. **A lord is NEVER a wall, not even at full HP.** Close the gap with Hector or Hawkeye instead, or leave a weak enemy as a cork. Dropping Matthew on (1,29) while a bow nomad stood at range 2 on (1,27) killed him the same way.
1046	- Pent's Elfire (23x2, 100% hit) one-rounds nomad troopers; Louise's bow one-rounds the cls33 fliers from inside. By T35 the walls were trading 3 kills a turn for no damage.
1047	
1048	**s41 attempt 8 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 15 (Lyn, carrying Nils on (0,29), was killed after Marcus died on the wall). Before that: Dart and the Matthew he carried (EP12), Merlinus's tent (EP13), Nino (EP14).**
1049	- The opening was clean again through T11: T1 trades, T2 carry the softs, T3 Marcus kills the sage on the (5,21) fort. On T4 Hector on (3,28) blocked the tent's approach, so only one enemy could hit it, and Pent Mended it from (2,29). EP4-6 killed the hero and all four generals on counters, then T6-T10 were a full lull (the whole SW showed '.').
1050	- **A carrier on a reachable tile loses BOTH units.** Dart carrying Matthew on (1,28) was doubled by bows from range 2 and both died. Never carry on a tile with any range-2 exposure.
1051	- **The real loss: Marcus was left at 15/39 on wall (2,28) while Pent attacked instead of healing.** He died, (2,28) opened, and a bow at (1,28) reached Lyn at range 2 on the "safe" corner while she carried Nils. **RULE: every wall at or above ~30 HP before ending the turn; heal before attacking.** The lords' corner is safe only while ALL of (0,26)/(1,27)/(2,28)/(2,29) hold.
1052	- Tool traps this attempt: a staff use right after a free GIVE marked Pent spent without healing; Wil's Elixir item menu failed and also spent him; `take` is not offered after a `give` on the same unit. Verify with `fe7_state` after every heal or item.
1053	- **Plan v5 (next attempt):** walls Hawkeye (0,26), Hector (1,27), Marcus (2,28), Pent (2,29) (Pent heals Marcus and the tent and is reachable only by bows while the tent stands). Lyn (0,29) and Eliwood (0,28) each carry one soft. Nils stands uncarried on (1,29) to Play Pent for a second heal each turn, Louise unencumbered on (1,28), Dart on (0,27). Hand Hector and Hawkeye an Elixir stack each during the T6-T10 lull. Expect the two leftover softs to die.
1054	
1055	**s41 attempt 9 result: GAME OVER on enemy phase 37 (Hector, carrying Eliwood, fell at 6 HP with no healing left).** Deaths, in order: tent (EP13), Dart+Nino (EP14), Nils and Marcus (EP15), Wil (EP16), Pent and Louise (EP29), Matthew and Florina (EP30).
1056	- T1-T11 had no losses (same opening as attempt 8, plus an Elixir for Marcus on T2). Layout v5 held until the tent fell on EP13. Nils's Play gave Pent two heals a turn, which worked very well.
1057	- **The best defensive shape found: the tanks CARRY the lords in the corner.** From T30, Hawkeye carried Lyn on (0,29) and Hector carried Eliwood on (0,28). Carried lords cannot be targeted, and doubled hits on Def 17/20 are small (Hector lost about 6-10 per phase, Hawkeye 4-9). It failed only because no healer and no weapons were left by then.
1058	- **Resources run out around T30:** Hawkeye broke a Silver Axe, a Killer Axe and Lyn's Silver Axe (60 uses) by T34; Pent's Elfire ran low (Louise gave him her Elfire x30); every Elixir was gone by T32. The convoy (Merlinus's Supply command, next to the tent) has Fire x40, Lightning and a Killing Edge that went unused.
1059	- **Reinforcements seem to stop around T35.** The count went 50, 49, 48, 46, 45 on T35-37 with no refills.
1060	- Tool traps: `item` right after a free trade/give fails AND spends the unit; drive it by hand instead (select, A, A, Down to Item, A, Up to wrap to the last entry, A, A). The tool's `staff` after a free trade also failed. `take` is not offered after `give`.

"Seize gate" (in-game "Ch. 30: Victory or Death"; no prep screen). Map 28x30. The gate (24,3) is in the NE, behind 2C walls; it is entered from (24,4). The boss (ch85, cls23, 68 HP, Def 21, Res 25, Bolting x5 at 3-10 + Fimbulvetr 1-2) sits on it. The army starts in the SW corner (x0-7, rows 25-29) with Merlinus's tent at (3,29). Renault's ruins are at (5,2) in the NW (visit within 11 turns).

**Recruits:**

| character   | starts as | recruit with / action            | important condition            |
| ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| **renault** | ruins     | **visit the northwestern ruins** | must do so **within 11 turns** |

**Agent notes:**

**s38 attempt 1 (RESTARTED on turn 14 after Matthew (T2), Nils (T5) and Wil (T13) died; Merlinus's tent was knocked out T12).**
- **Sage E#12 (9,17), Bolting 3-10:** it kills Res-0 units from 16 tiles away (Matthew died T2). Kill it on T2-3; it walks onto the fort (5,21). Marcus 23x2 kills it with no counter (it equips Bolting).
- Turn-1 wedge in the corner worked: Marcus/Hawkeye/Hector walls, the rest on tiles `fe7_threat` shows as '.'. The two paladins from the forts (4,20)/(5,21) died on Marcus's counters on EP1. The generals (13,22-24) and the warrior arrive T3-5 and die to Pent's Elfire (Res 2-4, doubles) and Rapier/axes.
- **Ballistas (trap array 0x0203A518): Iron Ballista (3,11), Ballista (4,25) (empty, next to the start), Iron (19,28), Iron (11,17), Killer (16,11), (17,1), (26,9). Range is about 15 tiles, not 10.** Sniper E#20 walks onto (3,11) on T4 and one-shot Nils at distance 15. E#21 sits on (19,28).
- **Reinforcements, every turn from about T6:** NW fighters/warriors appear AT (0-1,9-12) (T7), lance cavalry and paladins at (1,0)/(3,0)/(7-9,0-1), fighters at (16,0), nomad troopers (steel bow + steel sword, Spd 15-18) at the SE forts (26-27,28-29), wyverns at (27,16-18), and **paladins spawn on the start-area forts (4,20)/(5,21) from T11**. By T10 there were 49 enemies. The 8 centre wyvern lords and the falcon knights start moving about T12.
- The west corridor (x0-1, rows 15-19; x2-4 are peaks) is a good 2-wide choke. But the army got squeezed between the NW waves and the SE nomads, with fliers landing on the peaks.
- **Mistake: a canto after rescue can't cross the forest (1,19)** (mounted forest cost). Eliwood got stranded at (2,21) carrying Nino at half Spd and dropped to 8 HP. Check `fe7_reachable` before relying on canto.
- **Next attempt:** turtle T1-5 the same way but keep Res-0/flier units out of the sage's reach on T1-2. Then move FAST. Turtling at the start just lets the reinforcement waves pile up, and the goal is a seize.

**s38 attempt 2 (RESTARTED on turn 13 after Dart and Wil (T11) and Nils and Matthew (T12) died).**

Pent's Elfire and Marcus finish the generals and the warrior on T4-T5. **The convoy holds only a Killing Edge, Fire and Lightning.**
- `fe7_act`'s Rapier/Killer Axe `weapon_slot` was refused ("single entry") in this attempt; only slot 0 got used. A forecast with `weapon_slot` re-equips, but it failed the same way.
- **The NW lance reinforcements (cls33) are FLIERS.** Louise's bows are effective (30x2, one-round). They arrive in pairs from (1,0)/(3,0) every turn from T6 and reach the SW corner around T10. SE nomad troopers (steel bow + steel sword, AS 15-18) arrive in pairs every turn from T8 and reach the SW around T11. Paladins spawn on the start forts (4,20)/(5,21) from T11. The centre wyvern pack plus 2 falcon knights start moving around T11-12. By T12 there were 50 enemies.
- **Sitting in the SW corner fails.** Fliers and bows reach any soft unit that isn't fully enclosed or carried, and a dropped unit can't act or move on its next turn. The ballista sniper at (19,28) shot a tank once; the one at (3,11) waits for weak targets.

content.text:
I won Chapter 32 (Victory or Death) on attempt 12, turn 83: Hawkeye killed the boss and Eliwood seized the gate. The game then auto-loaded the Final Chapter (Light, "Defeat Nergal"), and it is sitting at turn 1.

- **Attempts 11 and 12:** Attempt 11 kept the boss weapons safe, but Pent and Louise died to a wyvern during the march, which left no healing. I ended it deliberately at T61 with a game over, since that is the only route to Restart Chapter. Attempt 12 then won.
- **Losses in the winning attempt:** Nino and Merlinus's tent fell on enemy phase 4. Matthew and Wil fell on EP10, Florina EP11, Dart EP12, Marcus EP15 and Nils EP58. Survivors are Eliwood, Hector, Lyn, Hawkeye, Pent and Louise.
- **How it was won:** The boss's Fimbulvetr tome slows him enough that Hawkeye doubles him with the Killer Axe. Two exchanges took him from 68 to 20, and the next turn finished him. All five of his long-range Bolting casts missed or were wasted on Hector.
- **Saved state:** `playthroughs/2026-10-20_00-09/states/s41_ch32_victory-or-death.ss` (explicit path, at the start of the Final Chapter). I also saved in-game when the end-of-chapter prompt appeared.
- **`run_state.json`:**
  - The seven deaths above were added to `dead` (Merlinus not counted).
  - "Renault" was added to `unrecruited`.
  - The completed entry is `{chapter: "Chapter 32 — Victory or Death", attempts: 12, session: "s41"}`; I recorded 12 because `attempts` was tracking the attempt number.
  - `current_chapter` is now "Final Chapter — Light (two parts)" and `attempts` is 0.
  - The file is now written with escaped Unicode, so the em dashes appear as `\u2014`.
- **Strategy notes:** I appended notes for attempts 11 and 12 under the Chapter 32 section of `CURRENT_RUN_STRATEGY.md`. They cover the corner layout that held, the wyvern-bait method and the boss method.
- **Final screenshot:** `screenshots/2026-10-21_s41_ch32_final.png`.

Nothing is committed. Also, the Final Chapter starts with only six survivors and almost no healing: Pent's Mend and Heal staves are used up and only one Elixir is left.
